action_and_variation.conditional_interaction: a composite domain would create a scalar-B1 coupling through restricted variations, not through a new density
action_and_variation.distributional_role: cross-check only; no duplicate action term
action_and_variation.fixed_f_equivalence: surface and delta-function representations are equivalent when f is fixed and regular
action_and_variation.fixed_regular_surface_identity: integral_Sigma sqrt|gamma| L_B1=integral_M sqrt|g| delta(f)|grad f| L_B1
action_and_variation.reason_varied_f_changes_domain: delta f moves support and induces shape, scalar-flux, B1, and matching-pullback terms absent from the fixed-iota variation
action_and_variation.shape_status_conditional: finite only after center-manifold projection; the covariant embedding equation is the normal diffeomorphism Ward combination of bulk equations and the metric junction, not an independent new force law
action_and_variation.shape_status_current_action: absent because composite support is not adopted
action_and_variation.shape_variation: delta_iota S=integral_Sigma sqrt|gamma| zeta E_shape+tangential divergence+existing field equations
action_and_variation.two_cap_count: the common Z2 junction is counted once; cap bulk terms retain their existing multiplicity

configuration_space.B1_ontology_compatibility: not algebraically incompatible with independent intrinsic fields, but it changes the frozen fixed-embedding variational domain
configuration_space.classification: additional off-shell domain restriction/BHSM identification, not a consequence of the fixed-iota action
configuration_space.current_embedding: fixed iota in the provisional B1 domain
configuration_space.sigma_partial_relation: independent; never identified with bulk sigma

scalar_boundary.B1_and_matcher_term: their pullbacks contribute through the same induced zeta E_shape
scalar_boundary.conditional_result: level-set identity plus center-manifold-projected transversality, not simultaneous independent Dirichlet data
scalar_boundary.current_action_result: only the fixed-support Dirichlet condition; the composite identity has no variational force until the domain identification is adopted
scalar_boundary.fixed_support: delta sigma_Sigma=0 is an independently imposed Dirichlet variation
scalar_boundary.moving_domain_term: endpoint motion combines scalar flux/pressure with E_shape

threading_and_power.blowup_fold: S_Sigma^comp=[B-N0^2 delta sigma_hat/(n partial sigma_hat)-a0^2 partial_rho E]_Sigma0
threading_and_power.direct_q_positive: S_Sigma^comp=[B-N0^2 delta sigma/(n partial sigma)-a0^2 partial_rho E]_Sigma
threading_and_power.exact_remaining_input: adopt and vary a composite support domain with its projected transversality/threading operator, or derive a different action-selected endpoint condition for S_Sigma
finite_variations: tangent variations on a fixed (tau,s) fold center manifold
the branch endpoint response recovered from delta q
threading_and_power.fold_route: viable only after an action-domain choice, preferably evaluated for q>0 followed by a controlled q->0 limit
threading_and_power.radial_constraint_order: not derived in the stored scalar ADM operator and not invented here
threading_and_power.residual_kernel_dimension: at least one boundary trace remains; exact operator kernel not computed
singular_or_ambiguous: orthogonal directions with approach-dependent projective profile
threading_and_power.support_condition_supplies: one relation fixing zeta from the scalar profile
threading_and_power.threading_classification: one constraint on zeta but no condition on S_Sigma
